limitations: The inherited raw-router caches contain roughly six months per named period, not complete calendar years.
Binance spot history is structural evidence for OKX X-Perp transfer.
The relaxed win-rate gate is only valid for a supplemental route; portfolio win rate must still be tested.
Fees are excluded by user instruction.

protocol.exit: take a fixed fraction at 0.5R, move remainder to breakeven, target 2R
protocol.money: client-selected current-equity margin; evaluated at 3% and fixed 10x gross
protocol.role: supplement to the higher-win-rate hourly router
protocol.selection_reason: profit, no negative month, drawdown, frequency and >=68% supplement win rate
